usage.callShape: POST https://agentres.dev/api/book with JSON body {venue_id, config_id, party_size, day} and content-type: application/json. x402 wallet auth on Base (USDC) — booking costs 0.01 USDC; all setup/search/availability endpoints are $0 (wallet signs for identity only). (Registry alias url agentic-reservations.vercel.app also works.)
quirks: NOT a single-call endpoint: /api/book is the terminal step of a multi-step session flow. Prereqs that cannot be invented: a real venue_id (from GET /api/search?query=&city=), and an ephemeral config_id slot token (from GET /api/availability?venue_id=&party_size=&day=). Docs: 'Config IDs expire — always fetch fresh availability before booking.'

A LINKED Resy account is mandatory: GET /api/me must return resy_linked:true. Linking is a two-step OTP flow on POST /api/link-resy: step1 {em_address} sends a 6-digit code to the user's real Resy.com email, step2 {em_address, code} completes it. Field is em_address (NOT email). Without a linked Resy account /api/book returns 400 NO_LINKED_ACCOUNT and the 0.01 USDC is lost.
First-time wallet must POST /api/account {email} (after GET /api/me returns 401) before link-resy. $0 identity call.

REAL-WORLD IRREVERSIBLE ACTION: books an actual restaurant table on the user's Resy account. Provider warns automated bookings may get the Resy account suspended/banned. Requires explicit human 'yes' confirmation before calling (docs make this a hard rule). Use POST /api/cancel (after GET /api/reservations to get resy_token) to undo.

Base domain is agentres.dev; full schema at /openapi.json, agent guide at /skill.md. Only /api/book is paid (0.01 USDC); /api/me, /api/account, /api/link-resy, /api/search, /api/availability, /api/reservations, /api/cancel are all $0 identity-only.
Errors include retryable + next_step fields; 409 ALREADY_BOOKED = user already has a reservation there; 502 BOOKING_FAILED = upstream Resy failure.
usage.guide: This is a multi-step Resy booking flow, not a one-shot call — do NOT POST /api/book directly. First GET /api/me to check resy_linked; if false, run the one-time setup: POST /api/account {email} then the two-step OTP on POST /api/link-resy ({em_address} to send a code, then {em_address, code} — needs the user's real Resy.com email and the 6-digit code they receive). Then GET /api/search to get a venue_id, GET /api/availability to get a FRESH config_id (they expire), present a full summary and get explicit user 'yes', then POST /api/book {venue_id, config_id, party_size, day}. Read body.success / body.reservation_id / body.resy_token. Booking costs 0.01 USDC via x402 on Base; everything else is free. This books a real table and can get the Resy account banned — always confirm with the user first.
